g.text: You seem upset. Is it something I said?
Right. You never would have seen an animal on Deimos. Predasites are like infested dogs with big ears. You'd love them.
Ah right. You wouldn't know. It's an animal on Deimos. Don't worry your pretty little head over it.
I didn't love being called boring.
Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
big ears are always cute! u see predasites often? ^_^
Only one can live. You or your furry companion. You must choose.
Don't worry! I just chopped up a tasty meal for our furry companion.
Actually no. They're hard to get close to... and kinda violent.
Yeah! I'm good at sneaking up on them.
I'm even better at in-person hugs.
Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
pray tell, why do u need to get close to a wild animal on Deimos?
aaand why are we sneaking up on wild animals exactly?
ah right u wouldn't know. don't worry ur great big head over it ;)
It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
Conservation. I work to preserve Deimos wildlife.
wut do u think is the secret to a perfect hug? ^_^
No way! I did all this work and now you want to steal the glory of serving the dish?
Of course! Why don't you go ahead and serve the dish?
and grants you a fresh start
is there like... an over-population problem?
That was a joke. I'm actually part of a program to conserve them.
oh! that is so incredibly lovely ^_^
Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
that might be my new fave fact about u
it was a thumbs up btw. that first emoticon.
I bet we can make something yummy if we work together next time <3
I'm kidding! I actually conserve wildlife on Deimos.
aaah u got me! that's lovely ^_^
Just wait until you learn even more about me ;)
Thanks for clearing that up. LOL.
Ah. It all makes sense now.
I bet you're right. I'd like that :)
Not as happy as I am.
that must be cuz u made it with so much love ^_^
that's ok ^_^ u did ur best right? it's the thought that counts!
I'm glad ur not into hunting endangered animals <3
lol I look forward to it
don't worry, space cowboy. u can always count on me to share the wonders of the past ^_^
I'll leave u to it, chef!
my first emoticon was supposed to be a thumbs up btw ^_^
Oh. Thanks for clearing that up.
Ah. It all makes sense now.
but I'm going to say it's a predasite from now on!
Lol. You do whatever you think is best.
